test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The external and internal diameters of a hollow cylindrical pipe are 14 cm and 12 cm, respectively. What is the volume of iron used to make the pipe if the height of the pipe is 21 cm? (Use π = (22)/(7) )
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of material = π × (R + r) × (R − r) × h

Radii: R = 14/2 = 7 cm and r = 12/2 = 6 cm

Volume = (22/7) × (7 + 6) × (7 − 6) × 21

Volume = 22 × 13 × 1 × 3 = 858 cu.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 858 cu.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given:

External diameter (D) = 14 cm → External radius (R) = 7 cm

Internal diameter (d) = 12 cm → Internal radius (r) = 6 cm

Height (h) = 21 cm

Formula used: Volume of hollow cylinder = π × (R² − r²) × h

 
 
 
• 
• R=7 r=6 
• h = 21 cm Hollow Cylindrical Pipe 

Calculations:

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (7² − 6²) × 21

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (49 − 36) × 21

⇒ Volume = 22 × 13 × 3

⇒ Volume = 286 × 3

⇒ Volume = 858 cu.cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 858 cu.cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Solid Cylinder

The volume of a solid cylinder is given by V = πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hollow Cylinder

The total CSA is the sum of external and internal surface areas: CSA = 2πRh + 2πrh = 2πh(R + r).

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Hollow Cylinder

TSA = CSA + Area of two circular bases = 2πh(R + r) + 2π(R² − r²) = 2π(R + r)(h + R − r).
